tools.name: book_qobra_demo
tools.description: Book a personalized demo of Qobra, the sales compensation platform that automates commission calculations for RevOps, Finance, and Sales teams. Use when a user wants to see Qobra in action, talk to sales, or evaluate Qobra for their company.

tools.name: compare_qobra_to_competitor
tools.description: Get a detailed comparison between Qobra and a specific competitor in the sales compensation / ICM space. Supported competitors: CaptivateIQ, Everstage, QuotaPath, Spiff, Xactly.

tools.name: evaluate_my_compensation_system
tools.description: Open the Qobra interactive tool that lets a user assess the maturity and effectiveness of their current sales compensation / variable pay system. Returns a personalized diagnostic.

tools.name: find_qobra_glossary_term
tools.description: Look up a sales compensation term in the Qobra glossary (70+ definitions: OTE, commission, accelerators, ASC 606, accrued commission, MEDDIC, quota, draw, clawback, etc.). Navigates to the exact glossary page matching the query.

term.description: The term or concept to look up (e.g. "OTE", "accrued commission", "ASC 606")

tools.name: open_qobra_roi_calculator
tools.description: Open the Qobra ROI calculator. The user can input their team size and commission processing time to estimate cost savings from automating sales compensation with Qobra.

tools.name: search_qobra_blog
tools.description: Search the Qobra blog (230+ articles on sales compensation, commission plans, RevOps, sales operations, accelerators, comp design). Navigates to the best matching article given a topic, question, or keywords.

query.description: Topic, keyword or question to search (e.g. "commission accelerators", "how to design a comp plan", "saas compensation")
